title: 「形容詞 + to-infinitive 句」句型
formula: Thing + be + adjective + to + base verb + other information

formulas.formula: Thing + be + adjective + to + base verb + other information
Thing + be + adjective + for someone + to + base verb
Thing + be + not + adjective + to + base verb

examples.en: This story is easy to understand.
The website is easy for beginners to use.
examples.zh: 這個網站對初學者來說很容易使用。

examples.en: This word is not easy to remember.
It is expensive to learn English.

rules.en: Place the thing receiving the action at the beginning of the sentence.
rules.zh: 把接受動作的事物放在句首。
examples: It is easy to read this book. → This book is easy to read.

rules.en: Do not repeat an object pronoun after the to-infinitive.
rules.zh: 不要在 to-infinitive 後重複加入代名詞。
examples: Correct: This book is easy to read.
Incorrect: This book is easy to read it.

rules.en: If the verb requires a preposition, keep the preposition.
rules.zh: 如動詞需要介詞，必須保留介詞。
examples: It is comfortable to sit on this chair. → This chair is comfortable to sit on.

rules.en: To identify who performs the action, use for + someone.
rules.zh: 如需指出誰執行動作，可使用 for + someone。
examples: This bottle is hard for young children to open.

rules.en: This exercise focuses on saying that something is easy, difficult, safe, expensive or interesting to do. It does not cover other grammatical functions of to-infinitives.
rules.zh: 本練習集中訓練「某件事物做起來是容易、困難、安全、昂貴或有趣的」這種用法，不包括其他 to-infinitive 文法功能。
examples: The box is too heavy to lift.
I went outside to get some air.

benefits.en: This structure lets the listener know immediately what you are talking about. Put this book, the machine or the road first, then describe what it is like to use or do something with it; the focus becomes clearer.
benefits.zh: 讓別人立即知道你在談甚麼。先說 this book、the machine 或 the road，再描述它做起來如何，重點會更加清楚。

benefits.en: It turns a longer idea into one natural English sentence. The sentence ‘It is difficult to understand the report.’ can be rewritten concisely as ‘The report is difficult to understand.’
benefits.zh: 把較長的意思變成一句自然的英文。It is difficult to understand the report. 可以簡潔地改成：The report is difficult to understand.

benefits.en: It is useful for describing difficulty, price, safety and the experience of using something, such as easy to use, expensive to repair, safe to drink and comfortable to wear.
benefits.zh: 方便描述難度、價錢、安全性和使用感受。例如 easy to use、expensive to repair、safe to drink 和 comfortable to wear。

benefits.en: It is very practical in daily life. You can use it to review products, compare services, give safety advice, or describe study and work tasks.
benefits.zh: 在日常生活中非常實用。你可以用它評論產品、比較服務、提供安全提示，或描述學習及工作任務。

benefits.en: It makes your English sound more fluent. Once you master this structure, you do not need to begin every sentence with ‘It is...’.
benefits.zh: 令英文聽起來更流暢。掌握這個句型後，便不需要每次都以 It is... 開始句子。

sourceOmissions: The PDF supplies the Benefits and Important Rules content in Chinese with English examples, but not full English translations; the stored English explanations are faithful editorial translations.
The PDF title has no separate English subtitle; titleEn is an editorial translation.

zh: 使用以下句型改寫每句：事物／活動 + be + 形容詞 + to 不定詞。
